about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers motorcycle transport, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Supply and the towns around it.

services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.evidence: Yellow flatbed tow truck hauling a red motorcycle through a wooded area

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Yellow Captain Hook Towing flatbed truck parked outside

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Honestly the best around! My mother in law misty aka tree girl told me to call them when my sister car broke down an hour and a half away and they got the car and took it to the place it needed to go. Now this is the second time I called my mother in law for my sister car once again and danny showed up he was very nice and respectful and took care of the car and got it where it needed to go thank you so much you guys are the best !

reviews.author: Dawn McHale
reviews.text: These guys are great at what they do. Kevin was very thorough at completing paperwork, so I had no trouble with insurance covering the tow. Decided to call Captain Hook after waiting an unreasonable amount of time for someone triple A tried to send. When that company was a no-show after an hour and a half, I called Kevin. He was there when he said he'd be; tried to jump the car before towing, and delivered it safely to its destination. Highly recommend. (BTW, the guy triple A tried to send finally called after the vehicle was safely delivered to its destination by Captain Hook.)

reviews.author: Wendy Hardman
reviews.text: I dealt with Janna twice and she was very friendly. Sarah was the hero that towed my father's truck from a difficult spot to Holden Beach west end. She was so nice and helpful the entire time. We also met another male employee who was equally just as nice and helpful. I would Highly recommend this company! They were to us within 10 minutes!!!! Amazing staff!!!

reviews.author: James Warr
reviews.text: Had my car towed from calabash to his shop after a collision, they worked me with and we made an agreement on the tow fees and what to do with the car. It all worked out good for both parties. Also I called three separate times early morning, noon and evening and they always answered the phone. I’ll keep them in mind for my towing needs from now on

reviews.author: Karen Taylor
reviews.text: They towed my car which after everything was done took almost 3 hours. I was expecting to pay several hundred dollars...he charged very little I couldn't believe it. Driver was super helpful and nice. I wouldn't call anyone else... I will definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: Christopher Robb
reviews.text: I planned a move 3+ weeks ago. From day 1 I knew I found a company that not only wanted my business but continued to adjust to MY SITUATION and accommodate my every need and request. They answer the phone, they answer questions and they delivered! Brianna, Joe and the rest of the staff took such good care of me I would give them 200 stars if I could no joke ....this is the place to use. I will absolutely call them again

reviews.author: Taylor Mcleod
reviews.text: He is awesome !! Time efficient and just a great man all around ! Super friendly . He’s towed my car for me and he’s moved a building to my house and cut down a tree to get it in my back yard . A jack of all trades . Very affordable you wont regret spending money with him

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.text: Megan is so helpful, and the towing is second to none. He paid attention to every aspect of the vehicle and made sure that nothing was damaged. What a company.

reviews.author: Sherri Clark
reviews.text: Sara was caring n thoughtful. I was out of town (3hrs away) and I lost my rental keys and needed a tow and she wasn’t able to assist me but she kept me updated and sent another company to tow the car to my hotel. I appreciate it Sarah. Blessings to you and your business.

reviews.author: Tiffany Bates
reviews.text: My Aunt used this company to have her car towed after a fender bender. The window had shattered in the accident. We knew there was a storm coming and multiple people on scene asked the tow truck driver if she would cover the window. She assured us it would be covered. The car sat for 4 days with nothing over the window and now the electrical is ruined for the windows. None of the windows function and there were a bunch of lizards inside. They did not offer to reimburse any of the tow expenses or the daily charges for having the car there (totaling around $400 for a couple miles to tow) Only said that they would make sure it didn’t happen again. A lot of good that does my Aunt now, as she’s stuck with the cost of fixing the electrical on top of everything else. What a racket. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

reviews.author: Mazie Drake
reviews.text: This guy is awesome! Thought I needed my car towed but instead just had a minor problem and it started right back up! This gentleman drove from supply to holden beach to pick up my car and showed me it didn't even need to be towed. It started right back up and he said have a nice day with a smile on his face! Definitely reccomend this guy! Very polite, showed up on time, helpful and above all else HONEST. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Nick Holliday
reviews.text: Had to have boat & trailer towed on a Sunday night in the middle of nowhere. Captain Hook came out in a timely manner and towed the boat to his yard to for safekeeping overnight and to the marina the next morning. Pricing was very fair and he was helpful, even suggesting ways we could fix the trailer and not have to have it towed. But since it was Sunday night and nowhere was open to buy parts we couldn't make that work. Did a great job.

reviews.author: Wayne
reviews.text: They came and got an abandoned vehicle out of my yard. I called two other companies before this one and they both told me to call them next week because it was raining. Called Captain Hook towing and they were here not even an hour later in the rain/dark. Guy was very nice and considerate about my yard.

reviews.author: Molly Surette
reviews.text: I was driving from Myrtle Beach to Wilmington when my car stalled at a light on hwy 17. Trying not to panic, I called around & was referred to Captain Hook. Justin showed up almost instantly after I called. He had my car hooked up in a matter of minutes & checked to see if I had someone coming to pick me up. I did not. He quickly offered me the passenger seat in the tow truck, asked where I was headed, & drove me all the way to Wilmington. Justin was friendly/professional & put me at ease, not often a feeling you have as a solo female having car troubles & in need of help! I am so thankful for him & Captain Hook dispatch for getting him to me so quickly!

reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.text: Been dealing with Captain Hook Towing, and Nick, for a while. Best towing service you're going to find on the East Coast. Always available, is able to handle just about any situation, courteous, timely, and very cost friendly. ANYBODY that has ANY bad experience with this company is OBVIOUSLY the problem. Either by not being clear on what they want done, or just out of general stupidity. I am a firm believer that when you find a good company, you spread the word and stand by them, and this is one company I will gladly do that for time and again.

reviews.author: Deric Matthews
reviews.text: I have used this company at least 7 times to tow cars for distances over 30 miles and havent had an issue. Always fair priced and great customer service also prompt and never late! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Kristi Zdenek
reviews.text: My man's hot rod broke down recently, (1030pm) we called captain hook towing and he was there within 30 minutes to pick up the car and get it home. Very reasonably priced, and professional service.

reviews.author: Greg Thomas
reviews.text: Flat tire, no spare, no pump, no plugs, you could say I wasn't prepared at all. Called first thing in the morning after July 4th and he picked right up and had me where I need to be in about an hour, great service, friendly, pricing is great, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rick Pasour
reviews.text: Captain Hook Towing is a Excellent towing service. Mr.Josh was a professional at his job. My 97 gmc truck broke down on ocean hwy 17 today. He arrived within 30 to 45 minutes of talking with me on my cell. He was kind, polite and courteous tow truck driver. I will definitely use their service again.

reviews.author: Dimitri
reviews.text: Keith the tow truck guy who helped me was excellent great service came all the way from holden beach to Conway sc to get my car very much appreciated the gentleman who drove my wife back and forth from the car repair shop and back to her car so she wouldn't have to drive at night and then waited for her to get in the car to leave. Hes a good guy and good employee to have . Keith is the man.

reviews.author: Butch Felton
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the care & precautions used by the driver/operator to ensure there was no damage done to my car. Great job & I would call again if I need another tow.

reviews.author: Iolina Hodell
reviews.text: Really awesome guys! Some of the kindest people we’ve met. They got us out of mud in the most coordinated effort and they are super reasonable with pricing! Highly recommend for anyone in the area.

reviews.author: j lee
reviews.text: I've used them twice and if I need this service again I will definitely call them! Prompt and courteous, great job! Very pleased with this company.

reviews.author: Mitchell
reviews.text: I was in the mountains for the summer, but had a car parked in the path of a hurricane. They picked my car up right away and stored for nearly 4 months. The rate was extremely fair. Two thumbs up!

reviews.author: Kendall Stubbs
reviews.text: Would recommend this towing service 10 out of 10. Wheel on my my boat trailer broke tonight. Once I called the guy there in 20 minutes. Super nice guy and great pricing.

reviews.author: Lisa Fabrizio
reviews.text: Recently hired Captain Hook to tow a camper from Supply NC to Eastbend NC 4 plus hour distance.they got it moved and deliced in 30 degree weather.when it arrived it was 7 degrees.they went above and beyond to get the job done sucessfully .forever Grateful May God Bless them over & over

reviews.author: Joe Lordi
reviews.text: Nick is the man! Prompt, fair, communicates precisely what is possible from the get go. Genuinely wants to help if he can. Worth a call if you need towing assistance in the greater Myrtle Beach area. Saved the day for me.

reviews.author: Kenley Iley
reviews.text: Needed a car towed that had been sitting in a yard for a few years. Joe did a great job getting the car out of the yard and towed where we needed it. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Steve Chizmar
reviews.text: A very professional job in a very small space by a wonderful lady. If my car breaks down i hope she will be the driver that rescues me i highly recommend these folks.

reviews.author: Paula Sullivan
reviews.text: Very nice guy however he towed our car to a dealership left the key in the cup holder and drove off. Luckily the car was not stolen! I would not recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: Fast affordable service!!!! These guys are amazing definitely deserve more than 5 stars!! Highly recommended and greatly appreciated!!!

reviews.author: Christopher Alt
reviews.text: I would recommend this company to anyone they gave me a good price and best time Fran and beat there time frame they told me to give me a or in my camper tire the driver and the guy that was with him was so helpful with the situation cause I really didn't know how to hook up the camper to the sway bar hitch and they showed me that's what I call Coustmer service. 10STARS

reviews.author: Jimmy Fiddler
reviews.text: Today I had the pleasure of meetingA hard-workingYoung lady named Sarah. Very professional and polite. I was really impressed.Thank you Sarah. God Bless.

reviews.author: Tracy Schroeder
reviews.text: Driver went out of his way to make me feel safe and comfortable after being broke down on the side of 211. He was very personable, polite and funny.

reviews.author: The Furniture Project
reviews.text: Great service! They didn't exceptional job helping me out with my accident and recovery of my vehicle.

reviews.author: Don Minton
reviews.text: Ive had several vehicle towed,always there when I needed them ! Very reasonable price, drivers very courteous, + helpful! ,5 + rating!

reviews.author: Shell Sparks
reviews.text: So my car broke down at auto zone and i phoned cptn hook towing the same evening and arranged for it to be picked up the next morning(today) and they were awesome and very nice and fast as well.. This will be my towing company from now.on
